scope: Source and documentation comparison for maintainable Lapis terminal architecture
method: Resolve GitHub default-branch revisions through API; retrieve raw files at those revisions; inspect source, build manifests and tests; record hashes. Fetch official toolkit documentation separately.
evidence_level: source inspection; no upstream build or runtime qualification
limitations: Default-branch revisions are not release selections or dependency pins for Lapis.
Retrieved tests were inspected, not executed.
No GUI, GPU, latency, platform compatibility or session persistence was measured.
Project license observations are not a transitive dependency audit.
Lapis terminal engine, service language and rendering implementation remain unselected.
